issue_context.title: bootstrapping apps with `selector: '#app'` in `app.component.ts` is not working any more after upgrading to 9.0.0
issue_context.body:
# 🐞 bug report ### Affected Package The issue is caused by package `@angular/core` or `@angular/compiler` ? I don't know exactly. ### Is this a regression? Yes, the previous version in which this bug was not present was: .... Yes, in `8.0.0`, it does work. ### Description A clear and concise description of the problem... As title, when I'm using `#app`, it complains about `selctor 'app' not found`. ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction https://stackblitz.com/... ## 🔥 Exception or Error
## 🌍 Your Environment **Angular Version:**
**Anything else relevant?**
comments: This is a combination result of https://github.com/angular/angular/pull/23811#discussion_r198020909 and https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/11885, ID selector can never be correctly parsed in Angular compiler, but root element only make use of unparsed (raw) selector. @mhevery please do consider this as regression.
The issue doesn't repro in Jit mode (https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-xth7wc) but does repro locally with CLI.

> The issue doesn't repro in Jit mode (https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-xth7wc) but does repro locally with CLI.

@IgorMinar This is an Ivy issue, StackBlitz doesn't support Ivy yet even when using v9. The issue happens in both AOT and JIT (of Ivy).
@trotyl dang, you are right. I thought I hacked stackblitz enough to get to to run ivy in JIT mode, but that was not the case.
